title: Villa Playa: Steps to Beach, Ocean View, Epic Pool
description: This generous, beautiful villa is less than a 3-minute walk to Sandy Beach, with short walks to local restaurants and bars. After days lounging on the beach and exploring Rincón, refresh in your private 15×33 sparkling saltwater pool and backyard oasis, or unwind on the balcony overlooking the sea. Minutes from world-class surf breaks, snorkeling, pristine swimming beaches, and Rincón’s downtown shops, your stay will be relaxing, uplifting, and unforgettable.The spaceThis spacious, beautifully renovated three-story retreat is less than a 3-minute walk to Sandy Beach and features a sparkling 15×33 saltwater pool, poolside patio with grill, and inviting indoor–outdoor spaces perfect for families and groups.The ground level features a tranquil studio suite with its own bathroom and kitchenette—ideal for added privacy.The second floor, at pool level, includes the main kitchen and living area, a full bathroom, and two bedrooms: one king and one with two queen beds. Fully open the folding glass doors to create an effortless flow between the kitchen, living room, patio, and pool.The third floor offers another comfortable lounge area, two well-appointed bedrooms—one king and one with two queen beds—and two bathrooms, including an ensuite.Both upper floors open onto breezy balconies with lounge seating and ocean views from the third floor—perfect for morning coffee or winding down at sunset.Thoughtful touches included for your stay:~ Soft Brooklinen cotton sheets and towels~ Beach towels~ Beach chairs~ Beach umbrellas~ Cooler~ Snorkels, masks, and finsVilla Playa has a brand-new solar power system that supplies the majority of the property’s electricity, while also remaining connected to the grid.The home also has a generous backup water cistern, whole-house water filtration, and reverse-osmosis drinking water at the kitchen sink.Things to Note:Part of Villa Playa’s magic is its dreamy pool area, surrounded by lush tropical nature and wildlife. Leaves or seeds may drift into the pool. It is professionally serviced and cleaned every Wednesday, and a skimming net is available for quick touch-ups. The pool is refreshing and unheated.In the evenings, the island’s iconic coquí frogs sing from the nearby trees—a signature sound of Puerto Rico. On weekends, you may also hear some local nightlife in the distance, though it typically settles down as the evening goes on.We will always do our best to accommodate flexible check-in and check-out times when possible. Because Villa Playa is a large property and our cleaning and support teams have full schedules, early check-in and late check-out cannot always be accommodated. We appreciate your understanding.TRANSPORTATION:A vehicle is essential for getting around Rincón, as taxi service in the area is very limited.Rincón is approximately a 35-minute drive from Aguadilla Airport (BQN) and a 2 to 2½-hour drive from San Juan Airport (SJU).If you are flying into San Juan, there are also frequent short flights from SJU to Mayagüez Airport (MAZ), which is approximately a 25-minute drive from Rincón.Other things to noteA vehicle is essential for getting around Rincón, as taxi service in the area is very limited.Rincón is approximately a 35-minute drive from Aguadilla Airport (BQN) and a 2 to 2½-hour drive from San Juan Airport (SJU).If you are flying into San Juan, there are also frequent short flights from SJU to Mayagüez Airport (MAZ), which is approximately a 25-minute drive from Rincón.

description: Suite 8 is the best! Stay with us and feel the highest level of comfort and cleanliness. Soft sheets, fluffy towels. New gas grill. New air-conditioning. See the ocean under the stars from your private, delicious Jacuzzi on your private roof-top terrace. Why choose Suite 8? Because you need this vacation, and we want you to love it. Soak up the sun and sea at Suite 8, on Corcega Beach. -Kare Management, Rincón, PRThe spaceSuite 8 is the best! Stay with us and feel the highest level of comfort and cleanliness. Soft sheets, fluffy towels. Steps from a sandy bottom swimmable beach. See the ocean under the stars from our private rooftop Jacuzzi. Why choose Suite 8? Because you need this vacation, and we want you to love it. Soak up the sun and sea at Suite 8, on Corcega Beach. The friendly Stella Community of Rincon is close to everything, stores, local bars and restaurants, gift chops and more. Snorkel the reef - gazillions of lovely fish - or just have a swim at the beach, which is steps from our front door. We also have 2 paddle-boards for your use. Or, just relax and enjoy the beauty. Play in the sand. (We provide beach towels, chairs and an umbrella)Ours is the most spacious, well stocked, and private of all the Wave Coast units. Our style is modern and minimalist, while being fully equipped with top-of-the-line EVERYTHING. Furnished with comfy couches, local art, and the cool colors of the Caribbean. We have wi-fi, so you can stay connected, (but we suggest you just go off the grid and enjoy!). Including the roof-top terrace, Suite 8 is a spacious 3-story property (2100 sq.ft.), air conditioned throughout. Upon your arrival, you will receive an informative Guest Book that provides information about a wide variety of local attractions, excursions, beaches, restaurants, and resources. The ground floor living space has comfy sofas and easy chair, a flat-screen TV, coffee table, and sunny windows. From the living area, sliding glass doors open to the patio with dipping pool and picnic table. Kids and adults will love to cool off and play in the private dipping pool, which is crystal clear. The patio and dipping pool are yours alone, and the entire backyard area is fenced in. Modern, well equipped kitchen with pots, pans, serving ware, wine and martini glasses, coffee pot, tea kettle and coffee maker, cutlery, pretty dish towels, and every cooking tool you could need. We even stock the paper towels and dish soap. There is a dining table with 4 chairs, as well as a "bar" with 2 stools. There is also a modern, tiled ½ bathroom on the 1st floor with toilet and sink and mirror.On the 2nd floor, the large master bedroom suite has a queen bed, large dresser with mirror, sunny windows, closet, luggage stands, 2 bedside tables with reading lamps, and full modern tiled bathroom. The second large bedroom has 2 queen beds, bedside tables and lamps, 2 closets, cool local art, and another full modern tiled bathroom, right beside it. 6 adults can easily stay and have plenty of space, but it is equally great for a small party of 2. Couples on honeymoon or romantic vacations will be delighted, as will smaller groups of travelers. We also love kids, and have a 'pac-n-play', 'sippy cups', beach toys, and board games. Soft bedsheets, nice bath towels, and beach towels are provided. We even have a "magic closet" with sample sized basic products that you may have forgotten (like mini-tooth paste tubes, deodorant, band-aides, etc).Forgot to bring a book or finished the one you are reading? We have a small "library" that you can feel free to take a book or leave one for future guests. We even have books for little children.Our gorgeous roof-top terrace has a private jacuzzi, gas grill, mini-fridge, table and chairs, lounge chairs, another bathroom, and ocean views. Great place for breakfast, a cocktail, BBQ, or star gazing from the hot-tub.Our large, private garage is stocked with paddle-boards, beach chairs and umbrellas, snorkel masks, and beach toys. There is a FULL SIZE washer and dryer, because having clean clothes is a non-negotiable! Everything you need is within a mile or 2 of Suite 8. Downtown Rincon, Farmer's Market, Art Walk, coffee shops, delicious restaurants, fruit vendors, food trucks, pharmacy, playground, a sports complex, and 2 modern grocery stores.If you need any assistance we are always available and only a phone call away.-Kare Management, Rincón, PRWe provide:(Based on max guest count)1 large bath towel per guest 1 pool/beach towel per guest 1 washcloth per guest2 hand towels per bathroom *please ask for additional linen package if you would like more* Paper towels Toilet paper Hotel bath soaps Coffee filters Laundry detergent Dish soapDishwasher podsCleaning products Broom/ dustpan Mop/ bucket Long lighters for gas stoves and grills Tupperware All standard kitchen ware(drip coffee pot)Grill propane HairdryersIron Beach chairs Beach umbrellaCooler bags We do NOT provide:Spices OilCoffee Keurigs Ziplock/aluminum foil/plastic wrap Shampoo/conditioner Snorkel gear Sunblock Pool floaties Bluetooth speakers Ice (refrigerators in larger houses do not have water/ice makers connected bc they cannot keep up, ice is available at store nearby)Cancellation PolicyGuest receives 100.00% (less $500.00 cancellation fee) if cancellation occurs at least 90 days before arrival; No refunds within 90 days of arrival.
